{"headword":"contagious","explanation":"「contagious」在學測中常出現在健康、醫療或心理學討論中。除了描述生理上的「傳染」，更常被用來描述情緒或行為的「感染力」（如笑容、笑容，恐慌），這種比喻用法在閱讀測驗中非常高頻。","senses":[{"sense":"傳染的；具有感染力的","explanation":"指疾病透過接觸傳播，或指情緒、行為能迅速傳染給他人。","entries":[{"pattern":"contagious disease","pos":"adjective","translation":"傳染病","explanation":"指可以從一個人傳到另一個人的生理疾病，常用於公共衛生議題。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Doctors warn that the flu is highly <target>contagious</target>, so students should wear masks to prevent the virus from spreading through the school.","translation":"醫生警告說流感具有高度傳染性，因此學生應該佩戴口罩以防止病毒在學校中傳播。"}]},{"pattern":"contagious laughter/smile/yawn","pos":"adjective","translation":"有感染力的笑聲／笑容／打呵欠","explanation":"比喻用法，指某種正向或中性的行為能讓周圍的人不由自主地模仿。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The comedian's <target>contagious</target> laughter filled the entire room, making everyone feel happy and start laughing along with him.","translation":"那位喜劇演員有感染力的笑聲填滿了整個房間，讓每個人都感到快樂並跟著他一起笑。"}]},{"pattern":"contagious panic/fear","pos":"adjective","translation":"具傳染性的恐慌／恐懼","explanation":"比喻用法，指負面情緒如恐慌或恐懼能迅速在人群中傳播。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As the fire alarm rang, a <target>contagious</target> panic spread through the crowd, causing people to run for the exit in total chaos.","translation":"當火警警報器響起時，一種具傳染性的恐慌在人群中傳播，導致人們在完全混亂中奔向出口。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 tag (觸碰) 加上形容詞字尾 -ious","related":[{"word":"contagion","pos":"noun","translation":"傳染；傳染病","explanation":"由形容詞 contagious 轉化而來的名詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"contemplate","explanation":"「contemplate」在學測閱讀中常用於描述心理狀態、未來規劃或深思熟慮的過程。它比 think 更有深度，強調在腦海中長時間地、仔細地考慮某個可能性或決定，常接動名詞 (V-ing) 或名詞作為考慮的對象。","senses":[{"sense":"深思；沉思","explanation":"指長時間地、專注地思考某件事，或是在精神上凝視某物。","entries":[{"pattern":"contemplate sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"深思某事","explanation":"及物動詞，受詞通常是深刻的議題、人生目標或某個具體的景象。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the long walk in the quiet forest, the young man sat by the river to <target>contemplate</target> the meaning of human existence.","translation":"在寧靜的森林中長途散步後，這個年輕人坐在河邊深思人類存在的意義。"},{"sentence":"The artist spent hours in the silent studio, trying to <target>contemplate</target> the beauty of the sunset painting on the wall.","translation":"這位藝術家在寧靜的工作室裡花了好幾個小時，試著凝視並深思牆上日落畫作的美麗。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"ponder","pos":"verb","translation":"沉思；深思","explanation":"強調在腦海中反覆思考以尋找答案"},{"word":"meditate","pos":"verb","translation":"冥想；沉思","explanation":"強調進入一種平靜的心理狀態進行思考"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"考慮；打算","explanation":"在做決定前，對某個可能的行動方案進行評估。","entries":[{"pattern":"contemplate doing sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"考慮做某事","explanation":"後接動名詞 (V-ing)，用來描述在心中權衡利弊，尚未做出最終決定。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Feeling exhausted by the high pressure of city life, Sarah began to <target>contemplate</target> <pattern>moving</pattern> to a small village in the mountains.","translation":"感受到城市生活的高壓，莎拉開始考慮搬到山上的小村莊生活。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"consider","pos":"verb","translation":"考慮","explanation":"最普遍的通用詞，指在決定前思考"},{"word":"envision","pos":"verb","translation":"想像；展望","explanation":"強調在心中構思出未來的景象"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"contemplated","past_participle":"contemplated"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 templ (切、模具) 延伸至心靈的空間，由拉丁文 contemplari (觀察) 演變而來","related":[{"word":"contemplative","pos":"adjective","translation":"沉思的；深思的","explanation":"由動詞 contemplate 加上形容詞字尾 -ive 延伸而來。"},{"word":"contemplation","pos":"noun","translation":"深思；沉思","explanation":"由動詞 contemplate 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"contempt","explanation":"「contempt」在學測中通常出現在討論社會階級、法律裁決或人際衝突的閱讀文本中。這個字的核心概念是「輕視」，即認為對方低於自己的價值，因此在句中常與動詞 like hold, feel, show 或 treat with 等搭配，表達強烈的負面情感。","senses":[{"sense":"輕視；蔑視","explanation":"認為某人或某事完全沒有價值、不值得尊敬的心理狀態或態度。","entries":[{"pattern":"hold contempt for sb./sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"蔑視某人／某事","explanation":"表示心中對某人或某事持有強烈的輕蔑之情，hold 為核心動詞，常用於描述深層的心理狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The wealthy businessman <target>contempt</target> <pattern>for</pattern> those who had to rely on government welfare to survive.","translation":"那位富有的商人對那些必須依賴政府救濟金生存的人持有深深的輕蔑之情。"}]},{"pattern":"treat sb. with contempt","pos":"noun","translation":"輕蔑地對待某人","explanation":"指將輕視的態度轉化為具體的行為，treat with 結構在此處表示「以…方式對待」。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The arrogant prince treated the servants <pattern>with</pattern> <target>contempt</target>, speaking to them in a loud and insulting voice.","translation":"那位傲慢的王子輕蔑地對待僕人們，用大聲且侮辱的口吻對他們說話。"}]},{"pattern":"show contempt for sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"對…表現出輕視","explanation":"show 為動詞，y指將內在的輕視之情透過表情或行為公開地展現出來。","sentences":[{"sentence":"By ignoring the safety rules, the reckless driver showed <target>contempt</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the lives of other people on the road.","translation":"透過無視無視安全規則，這名魯莽的駕駛對道路上其他人的生命表現出輕視。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"disdain","pos":"noun","translation":"蔑視；鄙視","explanation":"強調認為對方不值得自己的關注或時間"},{"word":"scorn","pos":"noun","translation":"蔑視；嘲笑","explanation":"強調伴隨而來的嘲諷與輕蔑感"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"respect","pos":"noun","translation":"尊重；敬意","explanation":null},{"word":"admiration","pos":"noun","translation":"欽佩；敬慕","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 contempt (輕視) 來自拉丁文 contemptus (完全地-con + 輕視-temnere)","related":[{"word":"contemptuous","pos":"adjective","translation":"輕蔑的；蔑視的","explanation":"由名詞 contempt 加上形容詞字尾 -uous 延伸而來。"},{"word":"contemptuously","pos":"adverb","translation":"輕蔑地","explanation":"由形容詞 contemptuous 加上副詞字尾 -ly 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"dedicate","explanation":"「dedicate」在學測中常出現在描述個人成就、職業生涯或藝術作品的脈絡中。核心概念是將時間、精力或資源「專注地投入」於某個特定目標。要注意其最常見的句型是 dedicate sth. to sth./sb.，其中 to 是介系詞，後方必須接名詞或動名詞 (V-ing)。","senses":[{"sense":"奉獻；致力於","explanation":"將時間、精力或生命投入到某項有意義的活動或目標中。","entries":[{"pattern":"dedicate sth. to sth./doing sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"將某事奉獻給…／致力於…","explanation":"最核心的考點，sth. 通常是 time, life, effort 等資源。注意 to 是介系詞，因此後面接動詞時必須使用動名詞。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young scientist decided to <target>dedicate</target> <pattern>her life to</pattern> finding a cure for the rare disease that affected her family.","translation":"這位年輕的科學家決定將她的生命奉獻給尋找治療她家人所患罕見疾病的方法。"}]},{"pattern":"be dedicated to sth./doing sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"致力於…；專注於…","explanation":"由過去分詞演變而來的形容詞用法，強調主體對目標的忠誠度或專注度。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The university's new research center is <target>dedicated</target> <pattern>to studying</pattern> how climate change affects the migratory patterns of birds.","translation":"這所大學的新研究中心致力於研究氣候變遷如何影響鳥類的遷徙模式。"}]},{"pattern":"dedicate a work to sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"將作品奉獻給某人","explanation":"常用於書籍、音樂或藝術作品的序言中，表示對某人的感激或尊重。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The famous author <target>dedicated</target> his first novel <pattern>to his parents</pattern>, thanking them for their endless support during his early years.","translation":"這位著名的作家將他的第一本小說奉獻給他的父母，感謝他們在早年對他的無限支持。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"dedicated","past_participle":"dedicated"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 dedic (說、宣告) + 字尾 -ate (使…成為)","related":[{"word":"dedication","pos":"noun","translation":"奉獻；投入","explanation":"由動詞 dedicate 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"dedicated","pos":"adjective","translation":"盡心的；專用的","explanation":"由 dedicate 的過去分詞形式演變而來，可用於描述人或專用設備。"}]}}

{"headword":"defendant","explanation":"「defendant」是法律類閱讀測驗中的核心術語。在法律情境中，它與 plaintiff（原告）形成對立關係。理解這個字時，需將其視為「被指控的人」，無論是在刑事案件中被指控犯罪，還是在民事案件中被起訴要求賠償。","senses":[{"sense":"被告","explanation":"在法庭上被指控犯罪或被起訴要求履行法律義務的人。","entries":[{"pattern":"the defendant","pos":"noun","translation":"被告","explanation":"指在法律程序中處於被指控地位的個人或團體。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The lawyer argued that the <target>defendant</target> was not in the city when the robbery happened, providing a strong alibi.","translation":"律師辯稱被告在搶劫案發生時不在該城市，並提供了一個強而有力的不在場證明。"},{"sentence":"After hours of careful deliberation, the jury finally decided that the <target>defendant</target> was not guilty of the crime.","translation":"經過數小時的仔細討論後，陪審團最終判定被告無罪。"}]},{"pattern":"defendant's lawyer / counsel","pos":"noun","translation":"被告律師","explanation":"指代表被告進行辯護的專業法律人員。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The <target>defendant</target>'s <pattern>lawyer</pattern> tried to convince the judge that his client had acted in self-defense during the fight.","translation":"被告律師試圖說服法官，他的當事人是在打鬥過程中為了正當防衛才採取行動。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"the accused","pos":"noun","translation":"被告；被指控者","explanation":"常用於刑事案件，強調被指控有罪的狀態"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"plaintiff","pos":"noun","translation":"原告","explanation":"在民事訴訟中提起訴訟的人"},{"word":"prosecutor","pos":"noun","translation":"檢察官","explanation":"在刑事案件中代表政府指控被告的人"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 defend (防禦/辯護) + 名詞字尾 -ant (人)","related":[{"word":"defend","pos":"verb","translation":"防禦；辯護","explanation":"核心動詞，指保護某人或為某人的行為提供理由。"},{"word":"defense","pos":"noun","translation":"防禦；辯護","explanation":"指防禦的行為或在法庭上的辯護論點。"},{"word":"defensive","pos":"adjective","translation":"防禦性的；辯護的","explanation":"形容採取保護措施或在被批評時急於為自己辯解的狀態。"}]}}

{"headword":"deficit","explanation":"「deficit」在學測中常用於描述經濟、財務、或生理上的「不足」或「缺失」。在經濟語境下，它通常指支出大於收入的「赤字」，而在醫學或心理學語境下，則指能力的「缺失」。理解這個字時，應將其與 surplus（盈餘）形成對比記憶。","senses":[{"sense":"赤字；虧損","explanation":"指支出超過收入的金額，常用於國家預算、公司財務或個人理財。","entries":[{"pattern":"budget deficit","pos":"noun","translation":"預算赤字","explanation":"指政府或組織在一定時間內，支出高於其收入的金額。這是描述國家經濟狀況最常見的搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The government is struggling to reduce the national <pattern>budget</pattern> <target>deficit</target> by cutting spending on unnecessary public projects.","translation":"政府正努力透過削減不必要的公共計畫支出，來減少國家預算赤字。"}]},{"pattern":"trade deficit","pos":"noun","translation":"貿易赤字","explanation":"指一個國家進口貨物和服務的價值高於其出口貨物的價值。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the country imports far more electronic goods than it exports, it continues to face a huge <pattern>trade</pattern> <target>deficit</target> every year.","translation":"因為該國進口電子產品的數量遠高於出口量，因此每年持續面臨巨大的貿易赤字。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"shortfall","pos":"noun","translation":"不足額；缺口","explanation":"指實際金額或數量低於預期或所需之量"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"surplus","pos":"noun","translation":"盈餘；過剩","explanation":"指收入高於支出的金額，或數量超過所需"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 defic- (缺乏) + 字尾 -it (名詞)","related":[{"word":"deficient","pos":"adjective","translation":"缺乏的；不足的","explanation":"由名詞 deficit 延伸而來的形容詞，指某種必要成分缺失。"},{"word":"deficiency","pos":"noun","translation":"缺乏；不足","explanation":"指缺乏某種必要元素（如維生素）的狀態。"}]}}

{"headword":"defy","explanation":"「defy」在學測中通常出現在探討社會權威、科技突破或自然挑戰的文本中。其核心概念是「拒絕服從」或「使…成為不可能」。在解題時，應區分其作為「挑戰權威」與「挑戰常理」兩種不同的語境。","senses":[{"sense":"反抗；無視；拒絕服從","explanation":"指拒絕遵守法律、規則或權威人士的命令。","entries":[{"pattern":"defy sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"無視／反抗某事","explanation":"及物動詞，受詞通常是法律、禁令、傳統或權威指令。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Despite the heavy fines, some brave activists decided to <target>defy</target> the government ban on protesting in the city center.","translation":"儘管面臨高額罰款，一些勇敢的活動人士仍決定無視政府在市中心抗議的禁令。"}]},{"pattern":"defy sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"反抗某人","explanation":"受詞為權威人士，如父母、老師或領導者，強調對其權力的不認同。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The rebellious teenager often <target>defied</target> his strict parents by staying out late at night and ignoring their phone calls.","translation":"那個反叛的青少年經常透過深夜不回家並無視他們的電話來反抗他嚴格的父母。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"resist","pos":"verb","translation":"抵抗；反抗","explanation":"強調對壓力或權威的對抗"},{"word":"disobey","pos":"verb","translation":"不服從","explanation":"單純指不遵守指令或規則"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"obey","pos":"verb","translation":"服從；遵守","explanation":null},{"word":"submit","pos":"verb","translation":"屈服；提交","explanation":"強調在壓力下低頭"}]},{"sense":"使...成為不可能；難以... {"headword":"delegate","explanation":"「delegate」在學測中是一個多功能詞彙，名詞與動詞的讀音不同且語意區別明顯。名詞指被選出代表某群體的人，，而動詞則指將權力或任務「委派」給他人。在閱讀測驗中，常出現在政治討論、公司管理或學生會組織等情境中。","senses":[{"sense":"代表；使節","explanation":"指被正式選出或指派，代表一個團體、國家或組織在會議中發言或投票的人。","entries":[{"pattern":"a delegate to sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"出席...的代表","explanation":"指正式的代表身份。常搭配表示人數的形容詞或國籍形容詞。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young student was chosen as a <target>delegate</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the international youth conference in Paris to share his ideas.","translation":"這名年輕學生被選為代表參加在巴黎舉行的國際青年會議，以分享他的想法。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"representative","pos":"noun","translation":"代表","explanation":"最普遍的通用詞，指代表某人或某團體的人"},{"word":"envoy","pos":"noun","translation":"使節；特使","explanation":"explanation: 更正式，通常指代表政府在外交層面執行任務的人"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"委派；授權","explanation":"將權限、工作或責任交給另一人處理。","entries":[{"pattern":"delegate sth. to sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"將某事委派給某人","explanation":"這是最核心的動詞用法。注意後方接續的 to 介系詞，用以明確指定權限移交的對象。","sentences":[{"sentence":"A great manager knows how to <target>delegate</target> <pattern>important tasks</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> his team members instead of trying to do everything alone.","translation":"一位優秀的主管知道如何將重要任務委派給他的團隊成員，而不是嘗試獨立完成所有事情。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"assign","pos":"verb","translation":"指派；分派","explanation":"強調指派特定工作內容"},{"word":"entrust","pos":"verb","translation":"指派；分派","explanation":"強調基於信任將責任交給他人"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"retain","pos":"verb","translation":"保留；持有","explanation":"指保留權力而不將其交出"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"delegated","past_participle":"delegated"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 deleg- (委派、選出) + 字尾 -ate","related":[{"word":"delegation","pos":"noun","translation":"代表團；委派","explanation":"由動詞 delegate 加上名詞字尾 -ation 延伸而來，可指代表團體或委派的行為。"}]}}

{"headword":"equity","explanation":"「equity」在學測中具有兩個截然不同的核心語意：一是關於「公平與正義」的社會議題，二是關於「資產與股份」的金融商業情境。學生必須根據上下文（如教育、法律、財富）判斷其含義，以免與 equality（平等）混淆。","senses":[{"sense":"公平；公正","explanation":"指在考慮到每個人不同的起跑點或需求後，提供適當的資源以達成真正的公正。","entries":[{"pattern":"equity in sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"在…方面的公平","explanation":"常用於探討教育資源、醫療機會或法律權利等社會議題，強調分配的公正性。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To ensure <target>equity</target> <pattern>in</pattern> education, the government provides extra funding and specialized teachers to schools in remote mountain villages.","translation":"為了確保教育的公平，政府向偏遠山區的學校提供額外的資金和專業教師。"}]},{"pattern":"promote equity","pos":"noun","translation":"促進公平","explanation":"常用於描述社會改革或政策目標，旨在消除歧視與不平等。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The new company policy was designed to <target>promote</target> <pattern>equity</pattern> by ensuring that employees from all backgrounds receive the same promotion opportunities.","translation":"公司的新政策旨在通過確保來自所有背景的員工都獲得相同的晉升機會來促進公平。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"fairness","pos":"noun","translation":"公平；公正","explanation":"最通用的公平之意，指不偏袒任何一方"},{"word":"justice","pos":"noun","translation":"正義；公正","explanation":"強調法律或道德上的正確與公正"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"bias","pos":"noun","translation":"偏見","explanation":"指因個人主觀看法而產生的不公平"},{"word":"inequality","pos":"noun","translation":"不平等","explanation":"指資源或權力分配不均的情況"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自法語 équité，最終源自拉丁語 aequitas (平等/公平)","related":[{"word":"equitable","pos":"adjective","translation":"公平的；公正的","explanation":"由名詞 equity 延伸而來的形容詞，常用於描述分配方式公正。"}]}}

{"headword":"equivalent","explanation":"「equivalent」在學測中常出現在數學、科學比較以及社會議題討論中，用來描述兩者在價值、數量、功能或意義上「對等」或「等值」。要注意其作為形容詞時的用法，以及作為名詞時常接的介系詞 of 或 to。","senses":[{"sense":"對等的；等值的","explanation":"指兩樣東西雖然形式不同，但其效果、價值或數量在實質上是一樣的。","entries":[{"pattern":"equivalent to sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"與…對等；與…相當","explanation":"最常見的形容詞用法，用來對比兩組數據、金額或影響力，to 是介系詞，後接名詞或動名詞。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Buying a second-hand car is often <target>equivalent</target> <pattern>to</pattern> saving thousands of dollars compared to buying a brand new one.","translation":"購買二手車通常相當於省下了數千美元，比起購買新車來說。"},{"sentence":"Spending ten hours a week on hobbies is <target>equivalent</target> <pattern>to</pattern> having a part-time job in terms of time management.","translation":"每週花十個小時在愛好上，就時間管理而言，相當於擁有一份兼職工作。"}]},{"pattern":"the equivalent of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"與…對等的事物","explanation":"名詞用法，指某個事物在功能或價值上與另一事物等同。常用於比較兩種不同的系統或單位。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In some cultures, giving a small gift is the <target>equivalent</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a formal handshake in a professional business meeting.","translation":"在某些文化中，贈送小禮物相當於專業商務會議中的正式握手。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 equi- (相等) + val (價值)","related":[{"word":"equivalence","pos":"noun","translation":"等值；等同","explanation":"指對等狀態的名詞形式。"},{"word":"equivocate","pos":"verb","translation":"含糊其辭","explanation":"字根 root equi- (相等) + voc (聲音/說) 表示使用等價的詞彙來混淆視聽。"}]}}

{"headword":"erect","explanation":"「erect」在學測中兼具動詞與形容詞用法。動詞時常出現在歷史建築、城市開發或生物形態描述中，意為「建立」或「豎起」；形容詞則用來描述姿勢或結構的「直立」狀態。理解其核心概念為「由平至直」的垂直運動或狀態。","senses":[{"sense":"建立；豎起","explanation":"指將建築物、雕像或結構物從地面向上豎立起來。","entries":[{"pattern":"erect a monument/fence/wall","pos":"verb","translation":"建立紀念碑/籬笆/牆壁","explanation":"及物動詞，受詞通常是 monument, statue, wall, 或 fence 等實體構造物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To honor the fallen soldiers of the Great War, the city decided to <target>erect</target> a massive stone <pattern>monument</pattern> in the center of the public square.","translation":"為了紀念大戰陣亡將士，城市決定在公共廣場中心豎起一座巨大的石製紀念碑。"},{"sentence":"To prevent animals from entering the organic farm, the farmers <target>erected</target> a tall wooden <pattern>fence</pattern> around the entire property.","translation":"為了防止動物進入有機農場，農夫們在整個房產周圍豎起了一道高高的木籬笆。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"construct","pos":"verb","translation":"建造；構造","explanation":"較為正式的詞彙，強調建築過程"},{"word":"build","pos":"verb","translation":"建造","explanation":"最普遍的通用詞彙"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"demolish","pos":"verb","translation":"拆除；毀壞","explanation":"指將建立好的建築物徹底摧毀"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"erected","past_participle":"erected"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 erect (直立、豎起)","related":[{"word":"erection","pos":"noun","translation":"建立；豎立","explanation":"由動詞 erect 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"errand","explanation":"「errand」在學測中主要出現在生活化、日常情境的閱讀或聽力測驗中。其核心意義在於「為了達成特定目的而短暫外出」，因此常與 run, do 或 perform 等動詞搭配。學生應注意它與 journey 或 trip 的區別：errand 強調的是「瑣碎、例行且必須完成」的雜事，而非休閒或長途旅行。","senses":[{"sense":"跑腿；雜事","explanation":"指為了完成某個小任務（如買東西、寄信、取件）而短暫外出地進行的活動。","entries":[{"pattern":"run an errand","pos":"noun","translation":"跑腿；辦雜事","explanation":"最常見的固定搭配。run 在此處不表示跑，而是指執行或處理一件瑣碎的事情。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After finishing her homework, Sarah decided to <pattern>run</pattern> a quick <target>errand</target> to the nearby post office to mail a birthday card.","translation":"在完成作業後，莎拉決定快速跑一趟腿，去附近的郵局寄一張生日卡片。"}]},{"pattern":"run errands","pos":"noun","translation":"辦理雜務","explanation":"通常使用複數型，指在一天之中需要處理的多項瑣碎小事。","sentences":[{"sentence":"On Saturday mornings, my father usually spends a few hours <pattern>running</pattern> <target>errands</target>, such as buying groceries and picking up the laundry.","translation":"週六早晨，我的父親通常會花幾個小時辦理雜務，例如買雜貨和取洗衣物。"}]},{"pattern":"do an errand","pos":"noun","translation":"執行某項跑腿任務","explanation":"較為正式的說法，強調完成該項任務的動作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the student to <pattern>do</pattern> a small <target>errand</target> for her by bringing the printed handouts to the main office.","translation":"老師請學生幫她跑個小腿，將印好的講義送到行政辦公室。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"escalator","explanation":"「escalator」在學測中常出現在城市生活、交通運輸或現代設施的描述中。學生應注意其與 elevator (電梯) 的區分：escalator 是指「自動扶手梯」，而 elevator 是指在封閉空間內上下移動的「電梯」。","senses":[{"sense":"自動扶手梯","explanation":"指在公共場所如商場或地鐵站中常見的移動階梯，用於高效地將大量人群在不同樓層間輸送。","entries":[{"pattern":"escalator","pos":"noun","translation":"自動扶手梯","explanation":"指在商場、機場或地鐵站中常見的移動階梯，用以輸送乘客上下樓層。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When the crowded shopping mall opened its doors, hundreds of people rushed onto the <target>escalator</target> to reach the upper floors quickly.","translation":"當擁擠的購物中心開門時，數以百計的人湧向自動扶手梯，以便快速到達上層樓。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 escal (源自 escalate, 意為上升) + 字尾 -ator (指設備或裝置)","related":[{"word":"escalate","pos":"verb","translation":"升級；擴大","explanation":"比喻像扶手梯一樣逐步上升，常用於描述衝突、戰爭或價格的升級與擴大。"}]}}

{"headword":"essence","explanation":"「essence」在學測中通常出現在探討哲學、藝術、或科學定義的論述文中。它不僅指物質上的「精華/精油」，更常指某件事物最核心、最不可或缺的「本質」或「精髓」。","senses":[{"sense":"本質；精髓","explanation":"指某件事物最基本、最核心的特性，如果失去了這個特性，該事物將不再是其原本的樣子。","entries":[{"pattern":"the essence of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"...的本質／精髓","explanation":"最常見的結構，用來定義某個概念、文化或藝術作品的核心價值。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many teachers believe that the <target>essence</target> <pattern>of</pattern> education is not just memorizing facts, but learning how to think critically.","translation":"許多老師認為，教育的本質不僅僅是就記憶事實，而是學習如何進行批判性思考。"},{"sentence":"Although the movie changed some small details, it still captured the <target>essence</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the original novel perfectly.","translation":"雖然這部電影改變了一些小細節，但它依然完美地捕捉到了原著小說的精髓。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"core","pos":"noun","translation":"核心","explanation":"強調事物最中心、最重要的一部分"},{"word":"nature","pos":"noun","translation":"本質；天性","explanation":"指事物天生就有的特性"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"exterior","pos":"noun","translation":"外表；外部","explanation":"指事物的外在形式而非內在核心"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 ess- (存在, be) 加上名詞字尾 -ence","related":[{"word":"essential","pos":"adjective","translation":"必要的；本質的","explanation":"由 essence 延伸而來的形容詞，指不可或缺的。"},{"word":"essentially","pos":"adverb","translation":"基本上；本質上","explanation":"由 essential 加上副詞字尾 -ly 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"intervention","explanation":"「intervention」在學測中常見於社會、政治、醫療或教育類文章。其核心概念是「介入」或「干預」，指第三方為了改變某個不理想的現況而採取行動。學生應注意其後方常接的介系詞 for 或 in，以及它在不同情境（如政府干預、醫療介入）下的中文翻譯差異。","senses":[{"sense":"干預；介入","explanation":"指第三方為了阻止、改變或改善某個狀況而採取行動。","entries":[{"pattern":"intervention in sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"對…的干預/介入","explanation":"指在特定領域（如政治、經濟或他人事務）中採取行動以改變結果。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many people believe that government <target>intervention</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the free market is necessary to protect poor workers from unfair wages.","translation":"許多人認為，政府對自由市場的干預是必要的，以保護貧困工人免受不公平工資之苦。"},{"sentence":"The teacher's timely <target>intervention</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the argument between the two students prevented the fight from becoming a violent clash.","translation":"老師及時對兩名學生之間的爭吵介入，防止了這場爭吵演變成暴力衝突。"}]},{"pattern":"intervention for sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"針對…的干預措施","explanation":"強調為了達到某個目的（如治療或改善行為）而設計的特定行動方案。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Early <target>intervention</target> <pattern>for</pattern> children with learning disabilities often leads to much better academic results in the future.","translation":"針對學習障礙兒童的早期干預措施，通常會導致未來更好的學業成績。"},{"sentence":"The health department launched a new <target>intervention</target> <pattern>for</pattern> obesity to encourage teenagers to eat more vegetables and exercise regularly.","translation":"衛生部門啟動了一項針對肥胖症的新干預措施，以鼓勵青少年多吃蔬菜並規律運動。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"interference","pos":"noun","translation":"干涉；干擾","explanation":"通常帶有負面涵義，指不請自來、令人不快地介入"},{"word":"mediation","pos":"noun","translation":"調停；仲裁","explanation":"指在兩方爭執間介入以達成協議"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 intervene 加上名詞字尾 -tion","related":[{"word":"intervene","pos":"verb","translation":"干涉；介入","explanation":"核心動詞型態，意為在事情發展過程中進入其中以改變結果。"},{"word":"interventional","pos":"adjective","translation":"介入性的","explanation":"常用於醫療術語，如 interventional radiology (介入放射學)。"}]}}

{"headword":"investigator","explanation":"「investigator」在學測中常出現在法律、犯罪調查或科學研究的閱讀文本中。它指的是那些負責深入挖掘真相、收集證據的人。學生應將其與動詞 invest (投資) 區分開，重點關注其字根 investigate (調查) 的衍生關係。","senses":[{"sense":"調查員；研究員","explanation":"指負責詳細研究某件事或某個問題，以發現事實或真相的專業人員。","entries":[{"pattern":"investigator","pos":"noun","translation":"調查員；研究員","explanation":"指負責案件調查或科學研究的專業人員，常與證據收集 (evidence collection) 搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the sudden fire in the city library, the lead <target>investigator</target> spent several days searching for any remaining clues to find the cause.","translation":"在城市圖書館突然發生火災後，首席調查員花了好幾天尋找任何殘留的線索以找出起火原因。"},{"sentence":"The private <target>investigator</target> was hired by the company to find out if any employees were secretly sharing trade secrets with competitors.","translation":"那名私人調查員被公司雇用，以查明是否有員工在秘密地將商業機密分享給競爭對手。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"detective","pos":"noun","translation":"偵探；偵查員","explanation":"通常指警察局內負責調查犯罪案件的人員"},{"word":"researcher","pos":"noun","translation":"研究員","explanation":"指在學術或科學領域進行深入研究的人"},{"word":"analyst","pos":"noun","translation":"分析師","explanation":"指透過數據分析來揭露事實的人"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 investigate (調查) + 名詞字尾 -or (人)","related":[{"word":"investigate","pos":"verb","translation":"調查；研究","explanation":"核心動詞，指深入研究以獲取事實。"},{"word":"investigation","pos":"noun","translation":"調查；研究","explanation":"由動詞 investigate 加上名詞字尾 -ion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"investigative","pos":"adjective","translation":"調查的；偵查的","explanation":"由動詞 investigate 加上形容詞字尾 -ive 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"irony","explanation":"「irony」在學測閱讀中常出現在文學分析或社會評論類文章中。它不僅是指「反諷」這種修辭法，更多時候是指現實與預期之間產生的強烈對比。理解這個字時，應將其視為一種「反差」的概念，而非單單的翻譯。","senses":[{"sense":"反諷；諷刺","explanation":"一種表達方式，用來表達與字面意義相反的意圖，或指事情的發展結果與預期完全相反的滑稽情況。","entries":[{"pattern":"the irony of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的反諷之處","explanation":"用來指出某個特定情況中存在的不合理或矛盾之處，是寫作中引導讀者思考對比的常用句型。","sentences":[{"sentence":"<pattern>The</pattern> <target>irony</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the situation was that the professional fire chief's own house burned down because he forgot to check the smoke alarms.","translation":"這個情況最大的反諷之處在於，那位專業的消防局長自己的房子竟然因為他忘了檢查煙霧報警器而燒毀了。"}]},{"pattern":"the irony is that...","pos":"noun","translation":"諷刺的是…","explanation":"用來引導一個名詞子句，描述一個出乎意料且具有矛盾感的結果。","sentences":[{"sentence":"<pattern>The</pattern> <target>irony</target> <pattern>is</pattern> <pattern>that</pattern> the man who spent his entire life fighting for environmental protection ended up living in a city with the worst air pollution.","translation":"諷刺的是，那個花了一輩子對抗環境污染的人，最後竟然住在一個空氣污染最嚴重的城市。"}]},{"pattern":"bitter irony","pos":"noun","translation":"極其殘酷的反諷","explanation":"用來描述一種令人心酸或痛苦的諷刺感，常用於文學分析中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"It was a <target>bitter irony</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the famous doctor died from a common cold because he was too busy to take a care of himself.","translation":"那位著名的醫生竟然因為太忙而沒能照顧好自己，最終死於普通感冒，這真是極其殘酷的反諷。"}]},{"pattern":"situational irony","pos":"noun","translation":"情境反諷","explanation":"指實際發生的事情與預期完全相反的情況。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The story uses <target>situational irony</target> when the character spends hours searching for his glasses, only to find them on his forehead.","translation":"故事中使用了情境反諷，角色花了好幾個小時尋找眼鏡，結果發現眼鏡就在他的額頭上。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自希臘語 eironeia (偽裝、假裝)","related":[{"word":"ironic","pos":"adjective","translation":"反諷的；諷刺的","explanation":"形容詞型態，用來描述一個具有反差或矛盾感的情況。"}]}}

{"headword":"overhead","explanation":"「overhead」在學測中具有多重身份。作為形容詞或副詞時，通常與空間位置相關，描述事物在「頭頂上方」；而作為名詞時，則轉化為經濟學中的「營運成本」或「固定開支」，這是閱讀測驗中關於創業、商業管理或公司經營類文章的關鍵考點。建議學生將其區分為「空間位置」與「經濟成本」兩大概念記憶。","senses":[{"sense":"在頭頂上方","explanation":"指物理空間上位於上方，或在上方懸掛、經過。","entries":[{"pattern":"overhead","pos":"adverb","translation":"在頭頂上方","explanation":"用來修飾動詞，描述動作發生在上方空間。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As the plane flew <target>overhead</target>, the loud noise woke up all the sleeping residents in the small village below.","translation":"當飛機在頭頂上方飛過時，巨大的噪音吵醒了下方小村莊裡所有正在睡覺的居民。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"above","pos":"adjective","translation":"在…之上的","explanation":"泛指位置在上方"},{"word":"aloft","pos":"adverb","translation":"在高處","explanation":"較正式的用詞，指在空中"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"underfoot","pos":"adverb","translation":"在腳下","explanation":null}]},{"sense":"營運成本","explanation":"指經營企業時必須支付的固定開支，如租金、電費及保險金等。","entries":[{"pattern":"overhead","pos":"noun","translation":"營運成本；固定開支","explanation":"通常作為不可數名詞使用，指公司維持運作所需的日常開銷。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The new small coffee shop decided to move to a cheaper area to reduce their monthly <target>overhead</target> and save money.","translation":"這間新的小咖啡店決定搬到較便宜的地區，以減少他們每月的營運成本並節省資金。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"running costs","pos":"noun","translation":"運作成本","explanation":"指維持設備或組織運作的日常開支"},{"word":"expenses","pos":"noun","translation":"費用","explanation":"泛指所有支付的款項"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"由 over- (在…之上) 與 head (頭) 組成","related":[{"word":"head","pos":"noun","translation":"頭；領導者","explanation":null},{"word":"heading","pos":"noun","translation":"標題；方向","explanation":null}]}}

{"headword":"oversee","explanation":"「oversee」在學測中常用於描述職場管理、計畫執行或教育督導。其核心意義在於「從高處監督」，因此常與管理層 (manager) 或監督者 (supervisor) 搭配。學生應區分 oversee 與 overlook (忽略) 的意思，因為兩者拼寫相似但語意截然不同。","senses":[{"sense":"監督；管理","explanation":"負責監督某項工作、計畫或一群人的執行情況，以 ensure 正確完成。","entries":[{"pattern":"oversee a project / operation","pos":"verb","translation":"監督專案／運作","explanation":"用於描述管理某個具體計畫或組織流程的過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The experienced project manager was hired to <target>oversee</target> <pattern>the</pattern> entire <pattern>operation</pattern> of the new city library from start to finish.","translation":"這位經驗豐富的專案經理被聘請來監督新市立圖書館從開始到結束的整個運作過程。"}]},{"pattern":"oversee the production of sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"監督…的生產","explanation":"常用於工業或製造業背景，描述監督生產線或產品開發過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The factory head was asked to <target>oversee</target> <pattern>the production of</pattern> high-quality electric cars to ensure they meet safety standards.","translation":"工廠負責人被要求監督高品質電動車的生產，以確保它們符合安全標準。"}]},{"pattern":"oversee the implementation of sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"監督…的實施","explanation":"常用於政策、計畫或新規則的執行過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The government appointed a new committee to <target>oversee</target> <pattern>the implementation of</pattern> the new environmental policy across the country.","translation":"政府任命了一個新委員會來監督全國新環境政策的實施。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"supervise","pos":"verb","translation":"監督","explanation":"最直接的同義詞，強調對人的管理與指導。"},{"word":"manage","pos":"verb","translation":"管理","explanation":"強調對資源、時間或組織的整體運作管理。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"oversaw","past_participle":"overseen"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 over- (在…之上) 與動詞 see (看)","related":[{"word":"overseer","pos":"noun","translation":"監督者；管理人","explanation":"由動詞 oversee 加上名詞字尾 -er 延伸而來。"},{"word":"overlook","pos":"verb","translation":"忽略；俯瞰","explanation":"字面意為在上方看，但常用於指因疏忽而沒看見。"}]}}

{"headword":"recommend","explanation":"「recommend」在學測中常用於建議他人採取某種行動或推薦某人/某物。最關鍵的考點在於其後方接續的句型結構：它是 an-ing 形式（動名詞）或 that 子句（虛擬語氣）的常客，學生常誤用 to-V 形式，這是文法選擇題的重點。","senses":[{"sense":"推薦；建議","explanation":"根據對某事物的認可或對某人的信任，建議他人選擇或採取行動。","entries":[{"pattern":"recommend sth. to sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"向某人推薦某事","explanation":"及物動詞，將推薦的對象（物）放在前面，將被推薦的人（sb.）放在後面，搭配介系詞 to。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the local library is so quiet and well-organized, my teacher <target>recommended</target> the small reading room <pattern>to</pattern> me.","translation":"因為當地圖書館如此安靜且井然有序，我的老師向我推薦了那個小型閱覽室。"},{"sentence":"The travel agent <target>recommended</target> a cozy mountain hotel <pattern>to</pattern> the couple who wanted a peaceful vacation in the countryside.","translation":"旅行社人員向那對想要在鄉間享受寧靜假期的夫婦推薦了一家舒適的山間酒店。"}]},{"pattern":"recommend sb. for sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"推薦某人獲得某職位／某項獎勵","explanation":"常用於職場、申請學校或獲獎情境，指推薦某人適合擔任某個角色或獲得某個榮譽。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The principal <target>recommended</target> the hardworking student <pattern>for</pattern> the national scholarship because of her outstanding academic performance.","translation":"校長因為該名學生卓越的學業表現，推薦她獲得國家獎學金。"},{"sentence":"My former manager <target>recommended</target> me <pattern>for</pattern> the promotion to senior manager after I successfully finished the difficult project.","translation":"我的前任經理在我成功完成那個困難的專案後，推薦我升任高級經理。"}]},{"pattern":"recommend doing sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"建議做某事","explanation":"直接接動名詞 (V-ing) 作為受詞，指建議採取某項具體行動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To improve your health and reduce stress, the doctor <target>recommends</target> <pattern>taking</pattern> a short walk after dinner every day.","translation":"為了改善健康並減輕壓力，醫生建議每天晚餐後散步一十分鐘。"},{"sentence":"The guide <target>recommended</target> <pattern>visiting</pattern> the night market to experience the local street food and traditional culture.","translation":"導遊建議參訪夜市，以體驗當地的街頭美食和傳統文化。"}]},{"pattern":"recommend that... (should) do","pos":"verb","translation":"建議…（應該）做某事","explanation":"這是一個典型的虛擬語氣句型。that 子句中的動詞必須使用原形動詞，即使主詞是第三人稱單數，因為 there is an implicit \"should\"。這是學測文法考點之首。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The environmental group <target>recommends</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the city government <pattern>reduce</pattern> the use of plastic bags in supermarkets.","translation":"環保團體建議市府應減少在超市中使用塑膠袋。"},{"sentence":"My coach <target>recommends</target> <pattern>that</pattern> every athlete <pattern>train</pattern> hard and get enough sleep before the big competition.","translation":"我的教練建議每位運動員在大賽前應努力訓練並獲得充足的睡眠。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"suggest","pos":"verb","translation":"建議；提議","explanation":"語氣較 recommend 溫和，且同樣接 that 子句或 V-ing"},{"word":"advise","pos":"verb","translation":"忠告；建議","explanation":"通常由專家或長輩提出，語氣較為正式且具有權威性"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"認可；推薦","explanation":"對某人的能力或品質給予正面評價，使其被他人接納。","entries":[{"pattern":"be highly recommended","pos":"verb","translation":"被高度推薦","explanation":"常用於被動態，描述某個產品、電影或書籍受到廣泛的認可。","sentences":[{"sentence":"This classic novel is <target>highly recommended</target> by most literature teachers because it provides a deep understanding of human nature.","translation":"這本經典小說被大多數文學老師高度推薦，因為它提供了對人性深層的理解。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"endorse","pos":"verb","translation":"背書；正式認可","explanation":"強調正式的認可或支持"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"recommended","past_participle":"recommended"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 re- (再次/加強) + 字根 commend (委託/交給)","related":[{"word":"recommendation","pos":"noun","translation":"推薦；建議","explanation":"由動詞 recommend 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"commendable","pos":"adjective","translation":"值得稱讚的","explanation":"由字根 commend (稱讚) 加上形容詞字尾 -able 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"sentiment","explanation":"「sentiment」在學測閱讀中常出現在探討社會心理、文學評論或公共輿論的文章中。它與 emotion 不同，sentiment 通常指一種「基於特定觀念或想法而產生的持久情感」，而非瞬間的生理反應。理解其在「輿論」或「市場情緒」等特定語境下的翻譯至關重要。","senses":[{"sense":"看法；觀點；情懷","explanation":"指對某人、某事或一個議題所持有的主觀看法，通常帶有情感色彩。","entries":[{"pattern":"public sentiment","pos":"noun","translation":"公眾輿論；大眾看法","explanation":"指社會大眾對特定政策、事件或人物的共同主觀感受或看法，是社會科學類文章的高頻搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The government decided to delay the new tax law after realizing that public <target>sentiment</target> was turning against the policy.","translation":"政府在意識到公眾輿論正轉向反對之該政策後，決定延後實施這項新稅法。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"opinion","pos":"noun","translation":"看法；意見","explanation":"最普遍的通用詞，指對某事的主觀判斷"},{"word":"attitude","pos":"noun","translation":"態度","explanation":"指對某事持有的持久看法或反應方式"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"（基於記憶或懷舊的）情感；情懷","explanation":"指一種溫暖、感傷或懷舊的情感，通常與過去的記憶聯繫在一起。","entries":[{"pattern":"sentiment","pos":"noun","translation":"情感；情懷","explanation":"指對某事持有之溫暖或感傷的感覺。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The old man spoke with great <target>sentiment</target> when he described the small house where he grew up as a child.","translation":"這位老人用極其感傷的情調地描述他小時候成長的那間小房子。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"emotion","pos":"noun","translation":"情感；情緒","explanation":"泛指所有類型的心理感受"},{"word":"feeling","pos":"noun","translation":"感覺；感受","explanation":"較口語且通用地描述心理狀態"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 sent / sens (感覺、感知) + 名詞字尾 -iment","related":[{"word":"sentimental","pos":"adjective","translation":"感傷的；多情的","explanation":"由名詞 sentiment 延伸而來的形容詞，常用於描述過度感傷的傾向。"},{"word":"sentimentality","pos":"noun","translation":"多情；感傷","explanation":"指過度表現情感的狀態或特質。"},{"word":"sense","pos":"noun","translation":"感覺；意識","explanation":"與 sentiment 共享同一字根，指感官的覺知或常識。"}]}}

{"headword":"wary","explanation":"「wary」在學測中常用於描述人物面對未知、潛在危險或可疑資訊時的謹慎態度。它與 cautious 意思相近，但 wary 更多地帶有「警覺」與「懷疑」的意味，常用於環境保護、網路安全或社會心理類型的閱讀文章中。","senses":[{"sense":"謹慎的；警覺的","explanation":"對可能的危險、問題或欺騙保持高度警覺，不輕易相信或採取行動。","entries":[{"pattern":"be wary of sth./sb.","pos":"adjective","translation":"對…謹慎；對…保持警覺","explanation":"這是最常見的固定搭配，後面接名詞或動名詞，表示對某個對象或情況感到不安並因此小心翼翼。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because they had been tricked by online scams before, the elderly couple was extremely <target>wary</target> <pattern>of</pattern> any emails asking for money.","translation":"因為他們之前之前被網路詐騙欺騙過，這對老夫婦對任何要求金錢的電子郵件都極其謹慎。"},{"sentence":"Wild animals are naturally <target>wary</target> <pattern>of</pattern> humans, so researchers must move quietly to observe their behavior without scaring them away.","translation":"野生動物天生對人類保持警覺，因此研究人員必須安靜地行動，以便在不驚嚇到牠們的情況下觀察其行為。"}]},{"pattern":"wary look/expression","pos":"adjective","translation":"警覺的眼神/表情","explanation":"用作形容詞修飾名詞，描述人物在面對可疑情況時的視覺特徵。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The stray cat gave the stranger a <target>wary</target> look before slowly backing away into the dark alley.","translation":"那隻流浪貓在緩緩退回到黑暗的小巷之前，給了那個陌生人一個警覺的眼神。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"cautious","pos":"adjective","translation":"謹慎的","explanation":"泛指為了避免錯誤或危險而採取小心地行動"},{"word":"vigilant","pos":"adjective","translation":"警覺的","explanation":"強調在危險可能發生時保持高度關注"},{"word":"suspicious","pos":"adjective","translation":"懷疑的","explanation":"認為某人或某事可能是不誠實或危險的"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"careless","pos":"adjective","translation":"粗心的","explanation":null},{"word":"trusting","pos":"adjective","translation":"輕信的","explanation":"容易相信他人而不加懷疑"},{"word":"reckless","pos":"adjective","translation":"魯莽的","explanation":"完全不考慮風險而行動"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"warily","pos":"adverb","translation":"謹慎地；警覺地","explanation":"wary 的副詞形式"},{"word":"wariness","pos":"noun","translation":"謹慎；警覺","explanation":"wary 的名詞形式"}]}}

{"headword":"weird","explanation":"「weird」在學測中常用於描述不尋常、古怪或令人不安的事物。在寫作或閱讀中，它可以用於描述人物的行為、不可思議的自然現象或令人困惑的社會現象。要注意它與 strange 或 unusual 的細微區別，weird 通常帶有更強烈的「不可思議」或「超自然」的意味。","senses":[{"sense":"古怪的；不可思議的","explanation":"指事物不符合常理，令人感到驚訝、困惑或不安。","entries":[{"pattern":"weird","pos":"adjective","translation":"古怪的；奇怪的","explanation":"用來修飾名詞，描述其外觀、行為或特徵不尋常。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young boy wore a <target>weird</target> combination of a winter coat and flip-flops, which made all the other students in school laugh.","translation":"那個小男孩穿著一件冬裝外套搭配夾腳拖鞋的古怪組合，這讓學校裡所有其他學生都笑了。"},{"sentence":"Scientists were confused by a <target>weird</target> natural phenomenon where the sky turned a deep purple color before the storm arrived.","translation":"科學家們對一種古怪的自然現象感到惑，在暴風雨到來之前，天空變成了深紫色。"}]},{"pattern":"feel weird","pos":"verb","translation":"感覺古怪/不安","explanation":"用於描述個體在特定情境下產生的心理或生理上的不適感或違和感。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After spending three days alone in the deep forest, the hiker <target>felt</target> <pattern>weird</pattern> and uneasy about the surroundings.","translation":"在深林中獨自度過三天後，登山者感到非常古怪且不安。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"strange","pos":"adjective","translation":"奇怪的","explanation":"最普遍的通用詞，指不符合預期或不熟悉的事物"},{"word":"odd","pos":"adjective","translation":"奇怪的；奇異的","explanation":"指事物不符合常理或不對稱的情況"},{"word":"bizarre","pos":"adjective","translation":"極其古怪的","explanation":"極其不尋常，甚至到於荒謬的程度"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"normal","pos":"adjective","translation":"正常的","explanation":null},{"word":"ordinary","pos":"adjective","translation":"平凡的","explanation":"平凡的"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"weirdness","pos":"noun","translation":"古怪；奇異","explanation":"由形容詞 weird 加上名詞字尾 -ness 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"whatsoever","explanation":"「whatsoever」是 「whatever」的強調形式，在學測中幾乎只出現在否定句中，用來加強否定語氣，意思是「絲毫、完全」。它通常放在被修飾的名詞之後，而非之前，這是它與一般形容詞最大的不同之處，也是文法選擇題的常見陷阱。","senses":[{"sense":"絲毫；完全（用於強調否定）","explanation":"用來強調完全沒有某種事物，語氣比 whatever 或 at all 更強烈。","entries":[{"pattern":"no + noun + whatsoever","pos":"determiner","translation":"完全沒有任何…","explanation":"放在名詞之後，用來強調該名詞數量或程度為零。常接在 no 或 none 之後。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The new student tried to join the basketball team, but he had <pattern>no</pattern> experience <target>whatsoever</target> in playing the game.","translation":"那個新學生試圖加入籃球隊，但他完全沒有任何打球的經驗。"},{"sentence":"Despite the loud noise outside the classroom, the environment students showed <pattern>no</pattern> interest <target>whatsoever</target> in what was happening.","translation":"儘管教室外噪音很大，那些專注的學生對發生的事情絲毫沒有興趣。"}]},{"pattern":"none + whatsoever","pos":"adverb","translation":"完全沒有","explanation":"當名詞已被提及，使用 none 替代後，whatsoever 緊隨其後以加強否定語氣。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked if anyone had any questions about the complex grammar rule, but there were <pattern>none</pattern> <target>whatsoever</target>.","translation":"老師詢問是否有人對這個複雜的文法規則有疑問，但完全沒有人提問。"},{"sentence":"I looked through all the boxes in the attic searching for my old diary, but I found <pattern>none</pattern> <target>whatsoever</target>.","translation":"我在閣樓的所有箱子裡在尋找我的舊日記，但完全沒找到任何一本。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"at all","pos":"adverb","translation":"根本；絲毫","explanation":"最常用的否定強調短語，通常放在句尾。"},{"word":"whatever","pos":"pronoun","translation":"任何的","explanation":"whatsoever 的較弱形式，不具備強烈強調意味。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"由 what + so + ever 組成，-ever 字尾用來表示「任何」或「無論如何」。","related":[{"word":"whatever","pos":"pronoun","translation":"任何事物","explanation":"基礎形式，可用於肯定句或否定句。"},{"word":"whichever","pos":"pronoun","translation":"無論 whichever","explanation":"用於在有限的選項中進行選擇。"},{"word":"whoever","pos":"pronoun","translation":"無論誰","explanation":"指代人，表示不論是誰都一樣。"}]}}

{"headword":"wheelchair","explanation":"「wheelchair」在學測中常出現在社會福利、身心障礙權利或醫療康復等主題的閱讀測驗中。這個字屬於複合名詞（wheel + chair），學生應將其視為單一實體，並注意其搭配的動詞（如 use, confine to）以精確掌握文章的語境。","senses":[{"sense":"輪椅","explanation":null,"entries":[{"pattern":"wheelchair","pos":"noun","translation":"輪椅","explanation":"指供行動不便者使用的移動設備。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The hospital provides a free <target>wheelchair</target> for elderly patients who find it difficult to walk long distances between different rooms.","translation":"醫院為那些發現自己在不同房間之間行走長距離有困難的高齡患者提供免費輪椅。"},{"sentence":"After the serious car accident, the man <pattern>was confined to</pattern> a <target>wheelchair</target> for several months during his recovery period.","translation":"在嚴重車禍後，該男子在康復期間數月被限制在輪椅上。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"輪椅的/輪椅用的","explanation":"當名詞用作定語（attributive noun）時，用來修飾後面的名詞，表示與輪椅相關的設施或設備。","entries":[{"pattern":"wheelchair [noun]","pos":"adjective","translation":"輪椅用的","explanation":"用作定語修飾其他名詞，如 ramp, access, user。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The local government decided to build a <target>wheelchair</target> <pattern>ramp</pattern> next to the stairs to make the building more accessible for everyone.","translation":"地方政府決定在樓梯旁建造一個輪椅坡道，使建築物對每個人來說都更方便進入。"},{"sentence":"The new shopping mall has excellent <target>wheelchair</target> <pattern>access</pattern>, allowing people with disabilities to move around the store freely.","translation":"這間新購物中心擁有極佳的輪椅通道，讓身心障礙者能自由地在店內移動。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"wheel (輪子) + chair (椅子)","related":[{"word":"wheel","pos":"noun","translation":"輪子","explanation":"基礎名詞，指圓形且可滾動的物件。"},{"word":"chair","pos":"noun","translation":"椅子","explanation":"基礎名詞，指供人坐的家具。"}]}}

{"headword":"whereabouts","explanation":"「whereabouts」在學測中常出現在偵探推理、失蹤人口或旅行紀錄類文章中。其最大特點在於其形式上看起來像複數，但作為名詞時，其動詞搭配可以是單數或複數，這在文法選擇題中可能成為陷阱。此外，它既能作為名詞（地點、行蹤） TSN 於其在句中的位置判斷其詞性。","senses":[{"sense":"行蹤；所在地","explanation":"指某人或某物目前所處的具體或大約的位置。","entries":[{"pattern":"the whereabouts of sb./sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"某人的行蹤／某物的所在地","explanation":"最常見的用法，通常作為主詞或受詞。注意此詞在句中常搭配單數或複數動詞（如 is 或 are）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The police spent three long weeks searching for the <target>whereabouts</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the kidnapped child, but they found no clues.","translation":"警察花了三個長週搜尋那名被綁架小孩的行蹤，但他們沒有發現任何線索。"},{"sentence":"After the secret agent disappeared from the hotel, his exact <target>whereabouts</target> remained a complete mystery to the government.","translation":"在那名秘密特工從酒店失蹤後， his exact whereabouts remained a complete mystery to the government."}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"location","pos":"noun","translation":"位置；地點","explanation":"泛指任何事物的物理位置"},{"word":"position","pos":"noun","translation":"位置；處境","explanation":"強調在一個空間中的特定坐標"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"大約在何處","explanation":"用來詢問或描述某人或某物大概的位置。","entries":[{"pattern":"whereabouts","pos":"adverb","translation":"大約在何處","explanation":"作為副詞使用時，通常在疑問句中出現，用以詢問大約的位置，語氣比 where 更模糊、更具詢問性質。","sentences":[{"sentence":"I cannot remember exactly <target>whereabouts</target> I left my keys this morning, so I have to search every room in the house.","translation":"我不記得今天早上我的鑰匙大約落在何處，所以我必須搜尋房子裡的每個房間。"},{"sentence":"Could you please tell me <target>whereabouts</target> the nearest post office is located, as I have to mail this package today?","translation":"你能告訴我最近的郵局大約在何處嗎？因為我今天必須寄出這個包裹。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"approximately","pos":"adverb","translation":"大約地","explanation":"單純強調數量或位置的近似值"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"疑問詞 where (何處) + 名詞字尾 -abouts (大約的範圍)","related":[{"word":"about","pos":"preposition","translation":"關於；在…附近","explanation":"核心基礎詞彙，表達位置的近似感。"}]}}

{"headword":"whereas","explanation":"「whereas」在學測中是極其重要的高階對比連接詞。它用於引導對比子句，將兩個截然不同的事實或狀況放在一起對比。在閱讀測驗中，它是辨識作者論點轉折或對比結構的關鍵信號詞，在作文中若能正確使用，可大幅提升句式層次感。","senses":[{"sense":"然而；儘管；而","explanation":"用於將兩個對立的事實、特質或觀點進行直接對比，語氣比 while 更正式。","entries":[{"pattern":"whereas...","pos":"conjunction","translation":"而…；然而…","explanation":"連接兩個獨立的句子，用來對比兩者的差異。通常放在句首或句中，兩句之間常伴隨逗號。其後接完整的子句（主詞 + 動詞）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Some people prefer to spend their weekends hiking in the quiet mountains, <target>whereas</target> others enjoy exploring the busy streets of big cities.","translation":"有些人喜歡在週末去寧靜的山區健行，而有些人則喜歡探索大城市的繁華街道。"},{"sentence":"The first candidate for the job had an impressive degree from a top university, <target>whereas</target> the second candidate had more practical work experience.","translation":"第一位應徵者擁有頂尖大學的令人印象深刻的學位，而第二位應徵者則擁有更多實際的工作經驗。"},{"sentence":"In the past, people relied on printed maps to find their way, <target>whereas</target> modern travelers use digital GPS apps on their smartphones.","translation":"過去人們依賴紙本地圖來找路，而現代旅者則使用智慧型手機上的數位 GPS 應用程式。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 where (何處) + -as (古英語對比接尾詞)","related":[{"word":"where","pos":"conjunction","translation":"在…的地方","explanation":"基礎連接詞，用於引導地點子句。"}]}}

{"headword":"whine","explanation":"「whine」在學測中常用於描述人物的情緒狀態或行為反應，特別是表達不滿或抱怨的語境。作為動詞時，它描述一種特定類型的聲音（高音、抱怨），作為名詞詞性時則指這種行為本身。注意其與 complain 的區別：whine 帶有更多的「孩子氣」或「煩人」的負面色彩。","senses":[{"sense":"抱怨；哀鳴","explanation":"指以一種令人不悅的高頻率聲音或語氣來表達不滿、疼痛或渴望。","entries":[{"pattern":"whine about sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"抱怨某事","explanation":"最常見的動詞用法，後接關於不滿之事的介系詞 about。通常指對小事或不合理的要求而抱怨。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The tired children began to <target>whine</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the long walk, even though they had only moved a few blocks.","translation":"疲憊的孩子們開始抱怨漫長的步行，儘管他們才走了幾個街區。"},{"sentence":"Please stop <target>whining</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the amount of homework we have, as it is the same for everyone in the class.","translation":"請停止抱怨我們有這麼多作業，因為全班每個人都一樣。"}]},{"pattern":"whine that...","pos":"verb","translation":"抱怨說…","explanation":"後接名詞子句 (that 子句)，具體敘述抱怨的內容。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The teenager started to <target>whine</target> <pattern>that</pattern> his room was too hot, despite the air conditioner working perfectly.","translation":"抱怨說他的房間太熱，儘管冷氣運作完全正常。"}]},{"pattern":"whine","pos":"noun","translation":"抱怨；哀鳴聲","explanation":"指那種高音的、令人煩躁的抱怨聲音。","sentences":[{"sentence":"I could hear the constant <target>whine</target> of my little brother's voice as he begged his parents for a new toy.","translation":"當我弟弟用那種聲音乞求父母買新玩具時，我能聽到他持續不斷的抱怨聲。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"complain","pos":"verb","translation":"抱怨","explanation":"最通用的抱怨詞，不一定帶有孩子氣的負面色彩。"},{"word":"grumble","pos":"verb","translation":"抱怨","explanation":"通常指低聲地、不滿地抱怨。"},{"word":"moan","pos":"verb","translation":"哀鳴；抱怨","explanation":"explanation: 指以一種低沉或痛苦的聲音抱怨。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"whined","past_participle":"whined"},"relatives":{"morphology":"單一形態詞，無明顯字根組合","related":[{"word":"whiny","pos":"adjective","translation":"愛抱怨的；聲音尖銳的","explanation":"由動詞 whine 加上形容詞字尾 -y 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"worship","explanation":"「worship」在學測中常用於探討宗教、文化遺產或極端崇拜（如對名人的崇拜）的文本中。它既可作為名詞也可作為動詞，且在語意上從「虔誠的宗教祭拜」延伸到「對某人的極度崇拜」。","senses":[{"sense":"崇拜；祭拜","explanation":"指對神靈、上主或具有神聖地位之對象的虔誠敬禮與崇拜。","entries":[{"pattern":"worship sth./sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"崇拜某事/某人","explanation":"及物動詞，直接接對象。對象可以是神靈或被視為完美的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In ancient Egypt, the people used to <target>worship</target> the sun god Ra, believing that he controlled the seasons and the floods.","translation":"在古埃及，人們過去習慣崇拜太陽神拉，相信他掌控著季節與洪水。"},{"sentence":"Many teenagers nowadays <target>worship</target> famous pop stars, treating them as flawless icons who provide an escape from the pressures of school life.","translation":"現今許多青少年崇拜著名的流行歌手，將他們視為完美的偶像，能讓他們從學校生活的壓力中逃避。"}]},{"pattern":"an act of worship","pos":"noun","translation":"崇拜的行為；祭拜","explanation":"名詞形式，指具體的祭拜儀式或行為過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The historic temple was once a center for the <pattern>act of</pattern> <target>worship</target>, attracting thousands of pilgrims every year.","translation":"這座歷史悠久的寺廟曾是一個崇拜行為的中心，每年吸引數千名朝聖者。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"adore","pos":"verb","translation":"熱愛；崇拜","explanation":"強調極度的喜愛或深情的崇拜"},{"word":"revere","pos":"verb","translation":"尊敬；崇敬","explanation":"強調基於對其高貴地位或品質的深深尊敬"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"despise","pos":"verb","translation":"鄙視；輕視","explanation":null},{"word":"scorn","pos":"verb","translation":"蔑視","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"worshipped","past_participle":"worshipped"},"relatives":{"morphology":"來自古英語 worth (價值) + ship (狀態/身分)","related":[{"word":"worshipper","pos":"noun","translation":"崇拜者；信徒","explanation":"由動詞 worship 加上執行者字尾 -er 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"worthwhile","explanation":"「worthwhile」是一個形容詞，用來描述某個行動或目標是否「值得花時間或精力」去達成。要注意它通常出現在 be worthwhile to do sth. 結構中，或作為名詞前的修飾語。","senses":[{"sense":"值得的；有價值的","explanation":"指某件事物在結果上能夠回報所投入的時間、金錢或心力。","entries":[{"pattern":"be worthwhile to do sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"值得（做某事）","explanation":"最常見的用法，後面接不定詞，用以說明具體值得投入的行動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Although the mountain trail was steep and difficult, it was <target>worthwhile</target> <pattern>to</pattern> climb to the top to see the breathtaking view.","translation":"儘管山路陡峭且困難，但為了看到山頂上令人屏息的美景而攀登是值得的。"}]},{"pattern":"be worthwhile","pos":"adjective","translation":"值得的","explanation":"作為形容詞補語，用來描述某個行動或經歷是否值得。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The teacher told the students that reading many classic books is always <target>worthwhile</target>, even if the stories are old.","translation":"老師告訴學生，閱讀許多經典書籍總是值得的，即使故事很古老。"}]},{"pattern":"a worthwhile investment / effort / cause","pos":"adjective","translation":"值得的投資／努力／事業","explanation":"作為定語修飾名詞，常用於描述一個目標具有正向且深遠的影響力。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Donating a small part of your monthly salary to a local charity is a <target>worthwhile</target> cause that helps many homeless people.","translation":"將你每月薪水的一小部分之小部分捐給當地慈善機構是一個值得的事業，能幫助許多無家可歸的人。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 worth (價值) + while (時間/一段時間)","related":[{"word":"worthy","pos":"adjective","translation":"值得的；配得上的","explanation":"強調對象具備某種特質而應得某種待遇或評價。"},{"word":"worthiness","pos":"noun","translation":"價值；配得上的資格","explanation":"由 worthy 加上名詞字尾 -ness 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"worthy","explanation":"「worthy」在學測中常出現在描述人格特質、社會價值或值得獲得某種待遇的語境中。最關鍵的考點在於其後方接續的介系詞搭配，尤其是 worthy of sth. 這一結構，學生必須將其視為一個固定單位來記憶。","senses":[{"sense":"值得的；配得上的","explanation":"指某人或某事具有足夠的價值、品質或特質，足以讓其獲得特定的對待、關注或獎勵。","entries":[{"pattern":"worthy of sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"值得…的","explanation":"最常見的搭配，後接名詞（如 attention, respect, praise, trust），表示該對象具有獲得這些東西的價值。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young scientist's discovery about renewable energy was so important that it was definitely <target>worthy</target> <pattern>of</pattern> <pattern>attention</pattern> from the global community.","translation":"這位年輕科學家的再生能源發現如此重要，絕對值得全球社群的關注。"},{"sentence":"After years of volunteering at the local shelter, her kindness and patience made her <target>worthy</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the high <pattern>respect</pattern> she received.","translation":"經過多年在當地收容所擔任志工，她的善良與耐心使她配得上她所獲得的高度尊重。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"deserving","pos":"adjective","translation":"值得的","explanation":"強調因表現或品質而配得某種結果"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"unworthy","pos":"adjective","translation":"不值得的；不配的","explanation":"指缺乏足夠價值或品質"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 worth (價值) 加上形容詞字尾 -y","related":[{"word":"worth","pos":"adjective","translation":"價值…的","explanation":"直接接名詞或金額，如 It is worth the effort."},{"word":"worthwhile","pos":"adjective","translation":"值得花時間的","explanation":"指做某事對時間的投入是值得的。"},{"word":"worthiness","pos":"noun","translation":"價值；配得上的資格","explanation":"由 worthy 加上名詞字尾 -ness 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"yacht","explanation":"「yacht」在學測中常出現在關於豪華旅遊、海邊休閒或富豪生活方式的閱讀文章中。它主要指一種大型的豪華私人遊艇，用於休閒、競賽或娛樂目的。","senses":[{"sense":"遊艇；豪華船隻","explanation":"指一種設計精良，用於休閒、競賽或娛樂目的的私人船隻。","entries":[{"pattern":"own a yacht","pos":"verb","translation":"擁有遊艇","explanation":"常用於描述富豪的生活方式。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many wealthy people <target>own</target> a <pattern>yacht</pattern> to enjoy their private time and escape from the busy city life during their vacations.","translation":"許多富有的人擁有遊艇，以便在假期中享受私人時間並逃離忙碌的城市生活。"}]},{"pattern":"sail a yacht","pos":"verb","translation":"駕駛遊艇","explanation":"指駕駛或操作遊艇在海面上航行。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The experienced captain was able to <target>sail</target> his <pattern>yacht</pattern> safely through the risky waters of the rocky coast.","translation":"這位經驗豐富的船長能夠安全地駕駛他的遊艇穿過岩石海岸的險險水域。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"yachting","pos":"noun","translation":"遊艇運動；乘遊艇巡遊","explanation":"由名詞 yacht 加上 -ing 形成的名詞，指一種高端的休閒活動。"}]}}
